intro: Lesson 21. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ (٣٨) إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ (٣٩) فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ (٤٠) عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ (٤١) مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ (٤٢) قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ (٤٣) وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ (٤٤) وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ (٤٥) وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ (٤٦) حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ (٤٧)

فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ (٤٨) فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ (٤٩) كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ (٥٠) فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ (٥١) بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ (٥٢) كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ (٥٣) كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ (٥٤) فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ (٥٥) وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ (٥٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained Except the companions of the right, [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
About the criminals, [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?" They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
Nor did we used to feed the poor. And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it], And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
Until there came to us the certainty." So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors. Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
As if they were alarmed donkeys Fleeing from a lion? Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
No! But they do not fear the Hereafter. No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder Then whoever wills will remember it.
And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Muddaththir 74:38-56 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 74:38-56 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 74:38-56 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, write how each of the four answers in 74:43 to 46 can guide your week.
questions.a: Pray on time; give food or charity; avoid idle, harmful talk; remember the Day of Judgement.

questions.q: Plan your home hifdh of 74:38 to 56 by day in the log.
Which is NOT one of the four answers in 74:43 to 46?
options: We did not feed the poor
questions.a: A) We did not travel. The four: not praying, not feeding the poor, joining vain talk, denying the Day.

questions.q: Think again: People in Paradise ask those in Saqar: 'What put you into Saqar?' Their four answers are in 74:43 to 46. Can you guess them?
questions.a: They did not pray, did not feed the poor, joined in falsehood and denied the Day of Judgement (74:43 to 46).
